t2.title: Public transport be free for everyone
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Should public transport be free for everyone?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
The idea of making public transport free for everyone is gaining popularity worldwide. I strongly support this proposal for several important reasons.

Firstly, free public transport would significantly reduce traffic congestion and air pollution. If buses and trains cost nothing, more people would leave their cars at home. Cities like Luxembourg have already implemented free public transport with positive environmental results.

Secondly, it would benefit low-income families who struggle with transportation costs. Many people cannot afford daily bus or train fares, limiting their access to jobs, education, and healthcare. Free transport would promote social equality.

However, critics argue about funding this initiative. Governments would need to increase taxes or redirect budgets from other areas. This is a valid concern that requires careful planning.

Despite the costs, the long-term benefits outweigh the expenses. Reduced healthcare costs from cleaner air, less road maintenance, and increased economic activity would offset the initial investment.

In conclusion, free public transport is an investment in a healthier, fairer, and more sustainable future. Governments should seriously consider this policy.

t2.sampleB1:
Dear MindMaze Team,

Thank you for the escape room experience. Overall, I enjoyed it. I thought the puzzle difficulty was pretty good, challenging but not impossible. The room theme was interesting, although maybe a bit too similar to other escape rooms I've done. The staff were helpful and friendly, especially when we got stuck on one particular puzzle.

In terms of improvements, I think you could add more interactive elements to the rooms. Also, I would like to see a room with a historical theme, maybe something about ancient Egypt or the Wild West. That would be really cool and different. Thanks again!
t2.sampleB2: Should Public Transport Be Free for Everyone? Imagine hopping on a bus or train without ever reaching for your wallet. It sounds like a dream, but many people believe free public transport could soon become reality – and I firmly agree. The biggest advantage is environmental. When travel costs nothing, drivers are far more likely to leave their cars at home, which cuts down traffic jams and clears the air in our crowded cities. Fewer cars on the road means a healthier planet for everyone. Free transport would also give a helping hand to those who need it most. Students, pensioners and low-income families often struggle to afford daily fares, and scrapping them would open up better access to work, school and healthcare. Of course, someone has to foot the bill. Critics rightly point out that governments would need to raise taxes or cut spending elsewhere. However, cleaner air and less congestion would save money in the long run. All things considered, free public transport is a bold but worthwhile step. In my view, the benefits far outweigh the costs, and it is high time our cities gave it a try.
t2.uzSample:
Hamma uchun jamoat transportini bepul qilish g'oyasi butun dunyoda mashhurlikka erishmoqda. Men bir nechta muhim sabablarga ko'ra bu taklifni qat'iy qo'llab-quvvatlayman.

Birinchidan, bepul jamoat transporti tirbandlik va havo ifloslanishini sezilarli darajada kamaytiradi. Agar avtobus va poyezdlar bepul bo'lsa, ko'proq odamlar o'z mashinalarini uyda qoldirishadi. Lyuksemburg kabi shaharlar allaqachon bepul jamoat transportini joriy etgan va ijobiy ekologik natijalarga erishgan.

Ikkinchidan, bu transport xarajatlari bilan kurashayotgan kam daromadli oilalarga foyda keltiradi. Ko'p odamlar har kuni avtobus yoki poyezdga pul to'lashga qurbi yetmaydi, bu ularning ish, ta'lim va sog'liqni saqlash imkoniyatlarini cheklaydi. Bepul transport ijtimoiy tenglikni rag'batlantiradi.

Biroq, tanqidchilar bu tashabbusni moliyalashtirish haqida bahslashmoqda. Hukumatlar soliqlarni oshirishi yoki byudjetlarni boshqa sohalardan yo'naltirishi kerak bo'ladi. Bu ehtiyotkorlik bilan rejalashtirishni talab qiladigan asosli xavotir.

Xarajatlarga qaramay, uzoq muddatli foyda xarajatlardan ustun turadi. Toza havodan kelib chiqadigan sog'liqni saqlash xarajatlarining kamayishi, yo'llarni kamroq ta'mirlash va iqtisodiy faollikning oshishi dastlabki investitsiyalarni qoplaydi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, bepul jamoat transporti - bu yanada sog'lom, adolatli va barqaror kelajakka sarmoyadir. Hukumatlar ushbu siyosatni jiddiy ko'rib chiqishlari kerak.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
Escape room yaxshi. Topishmoqlar qiyin. Xodimlar yaxshi. Menga yangi xonalar yoqadi, balki yirtqich hayvonlar bilan bo'lsa. Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom,

Escape xonasi juda qiziqarli bo'ldi! Topishmoqlar biroz qiyin edi, lekin do'stlarim menga yordam berishdi. Xodimlar do'stona munosabatda bo'lishdi va bizga kerak bo'lganda yordam berishdi. Menimcha, xonaning mavzusi yaxshi edi, lekin balki siz hayvonlar bilan yangi xona yasashingiz mumkin. Bu juda ajoyib bo'lardi. Rahmat!
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli MindMaze jamoasi,

Escape room tajribasi uchun rahmat. Umuman olganda, menga yoqdi. Men boshqotirmalarning qiyinligi juda yaxshi deb o'yladim, qiyin, lekin imkonsiz emas. Xonaning mavzusi qiziqarli edi, garchi men qilgan boshqa escape room'larga biroz o'xshash bo'lsa ham. Xodimlar yordam berishga tayyor va do'stona edilar, ayniqsa, biz bitta boshqotirmada tiqilib qolganimizda.

Yaxshilash nuqtai nazaridan, menimcha, xonalarga ko'proq interaktiv elementlar qo'shishingiz mumkin. Shuningdek, men tarixiy mavzudagi xonani ko'rishni xohlardim, ehtimol qadimgi Misr yoki Yovvoyi G'arb haqida. Bu juda ajoyib va ​​boshqacha bo'lardi. Yana bir bor rahmat!
t2.uzSampleB2:
Muharrirga,

Jamoat transporti bepul bo'lishi kerakmi degan savol murakkab, ammo menimcha, potentsial foydalari kamchiliklardan sezilarli darajada ustun turadi. Moliyaviy oqibatlari katta bo'lsa-da, jamiyat va atrof-muhitga ijobiy ta'siri jiddiy e'tiborga loyiqdir.

Birinchidan, bepul jamoat transporti shahar tirbandligini keskin kamaytiradi. Moliyaviy to'siqni olib tashlash orqali ko'proq odamlar shaxsiy transport vositalaridan ko'ra avtobus va poyezdlarni tanlaydilar, bu esa tirbandlikning kamayishiga va natijada karbonat angidrid chiqindilarining kamayishiga olib keladi. Bu o'zgarish iqlim o'zgarishiga qarshi kurashish va shaharlarimizda havo sifatini yaxshilashda juda muhimdir.

Bundan tashqari, bepul jamoat transporti ijtimoiy tenglikni oshiradi. Bu, ko'pincha jamoat transportiga eng ko'p tayanadigan kam daromadli shaxslar va oilalar uchun ish o'rinlari, ta'lim va muhim xizmatlarga arzon narxlarda kirish imkoniyatini beradi. Ushbu o'sib borayotgan qulaylik iqtisodiy imkoniyatlarning kengayishiga va hayot sifatining yaxshilanishiga olib kelishi mumkin.

Albatta, bunday tizimni moliyalashtirish modeli muammolarni keltirib chiqaradi. Biroq, mavjud transport byudjetlarini yo'naltirish yoki progressiv soliq tizimini joriy etish kabi innovatsion echimlarni o'rganish mumkin. Toza havo tufayli sog'liqni saqlash xarajatlarining kamayishi va yo'llarni ta'mirlashning qisqarishi natijasida uzoq muddatli xarajatlarni tejash ham hisobga olinishi kerak.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, bepul jamoat transportini joriy etish puxta rejalashtirish va moliyaviy majburiyatni talab qilsa-da, atrof-muhitimiz, jamiyatimiz va iqtisodiyotimiz uchun potentsial foydalari inkor etib bo'lmaydi. Bu yanada barqaror va adolatli kelajak sari dadil qadamdir.

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who is looking for fun group activities. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! I know you're looking for fun activities for your birthday! We just did an escape room and it was absolutely amazing! You solve puzzles with your team to escape within an hour. It's incredibly exciting, challenging, and perfect for groups. You should definitely book one! Can't wait to hear what you think! Cheers!

Bye!

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the escape room company. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear MindMaze Team, Thank you for your email asking about our recent escape room experience at your venue. My friends and I thoroughly enjoyed the detective-themed room we attempted. The puzzles were creative and challenging, requiring excellent teamwork to solve. The hour flew by quickly, and although we didn't escape in time, we had tremendous fun. Your staff were encouraging and provided helpful hints when we were stuck. I have some suggestions for improvement. Firstly, offering different difficulty levels for each room would help both beginners and experienced players. Secondly, a waiting area with refreshments would be appreciated, especially when arriving early. For future themes, I would love to see a space exploration or underwater adventure room. We will definitely return to try your other rooms. Yours sincerely, Zarina Qodirova
t12.sampleA1:
Hi MindMaze,

Escape room good. Puzzles hard. Staff nice.
I like space room.
Bye
t12.sampleA2:
Hi MindMaze,

I went to your escape room. It was fun, but the puzzles were difficult. The staff was friendly and helped us. I think you should make a new room about pirates because I like pirates. And maybe easier puzzles. Thank you.

Bye, Zarina Qodirova
t12.sampleB1:
Dear MindMaze Team,

Thank you for your email. I wanted to tell you about my experience at your escape room. My friends and I did the mystery room, and it was pretty good. The puzzles were challenging, but we liked that. The staff was also very helpful when we needed clues.

I think you could improve the waiting area because it was a bit boring. Maybe add some games or magazines. Also, a new room theme about ancient Egypt would be cool, in my opinion.

Overall, we had a good time and might come back again.

Sincerely,
Zarina Qodirova
t12.sampleB2: Dear MindMaze Team, Thank you for getting in touch about our recent visit to your escape room. My friends and I took on the detective-themed room, and I would like to share a few thoughts. On the whole, we had a wonderful time. The puzzles struck the right balance between tricky and solvable, and cracking them as a team was hugely satisfying. Your staff also deserve praise – they were friendly throughout and stepped in with helpful hints exactly when we needed them. That said, I do have a couple of suggestions. It would be worth setting up a comfortable waiting area with drinks, as we arrived early with nothing to do. In addition, a space-themed room would make a fantastic addition to your line-up. We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves and will certainly be back. Yours sincerely, Zarina Karimova

Bundan tashqari, steampunk uslubidagi xona yoki Sherlock Holmes kabi klassik adabiy asarga asoslangan xona sizning repertuaringizga qiziqarli qo'shimchalar bo'lishi mumkin.
